title: test(cli): os audit verify boots a stack that declares queues and assignment rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #34143

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加一个集成测试。`os audit verify` 在声明了一个队列和一条分配规则的应用上启动、读取已封存的审计台账，并给出正常结论(3 行均 unmodified,exit 0)。没有改运行时代码。
- 为什么改:下游 CRM 在 18.4.0/18.5.0 上跑审计台账校验时启动即被拒。main 上 #33879 已经修好(`bootSchemaStack` 组合了 ownership-queue 服务),这里补上卡片要求的回归测试，并排查了其它 CLI 启动路径。
- 风险与回滚：无运行时风险，只新增一个测试文件。回滚即删除该文件。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/audit/verify.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/audit/verify.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts`,预期 2 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Test only. No runtime code changes, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

`os audit verify` boots through `bootSchemaStack` (`packages/cli/src/commands/audit/verify.ts`, the `bootSchemaStack({ … extraPlugins: buildDataMigrationPlugins({ audit: true }) + crypto.plugins … })` call). Since #33879, `bootSchemaStack` composes `composeOwnershipQueueProvider` after the composition and the extra plugins (`packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`). That registers the `ownership-queue` service whenever the boot has no sharing provider. So ask 1 of the card already holds on `main`. The card's report was taken on 18.4.0 and 18.5.0, which predate that fix.

New file: `packages/cli/src/commands/audit/verify.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts` (integration tier). It spawns the real command from its source entry over a project whose artifact declares one sealed ledger object, one queue and one assignment rule. A child process writes three ledger rows of a settled window and seals them with plugin-audit's own sealer. The command must then boot, read the ledger and give its normal verdict: `ok: true`, `sealed: true`, 3 rows `unmodified`, exit 0, and no `error` key (never `boot_failed`).

### Sweep: every CLI path that boots a kernel

`git grep` in `packages/cli/src` (non-test files) for `new Runtime(`, `new ObjectKernel`, `new LiteKernel`, `createStandaloneStack(` and `new ObjectQLPlugin` finds two construction sites only: `utils/schema-migrate.ts` (`bootSchemaStack`) and `commands/serve.ts`.

| Command(s) | How it boots | Ownership-queue service | Fix needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audit verify`, `db orphans`, `storage orphans`, `secret orphans`, `secret rewrap`, `plugin trust add` / `list` / `revoke`, every `migrate` subcommand that boots | `bootSchemaStack` | `composeOwnershipQueueProvider`, unless the composition already provides `sharing` | no (#33879) |
| `serve` | its own kernel | `sharing` is on the always-on slate; `SharingServicePlugin.init()` registers it | no |
| `dev`, `start` | spawn `serve` as a child (`dev.ts` `spawnServeChild`, `start.ts` `spawn(… 'serve' …)`) | as `serve` | no |
| `verify` | `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack` | `harness.ts` always mounts `new SharingServicePlugin()` (`kernel.use(sharingPlugin)`) | no |
| `test` | no boot: `CoreQA.HttpTestAdapter` against `--url` | n/a | no |
| `doctor`, `validate`, `lint`, `compile`, `datasource *`, `data *`, `meta *` and the rest | no kernel construction site (grep above) | n/a | no |

The candidate files the order named and what they do: `utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts` builds plugin lists for `bootSchemaStack` and boots nothing. `utils/stack-collections.ts` reads stack declarations (`hasObjectQLPlugin` is a list check). `utils/extract-hook-body.ts` has no kernel construction. `utils/installed-plugins-boot.ts` calls `kernel.use` on a kernel passed in by `serve.ts`. `doctor.ts` names `EnhancedObjectKernel` only inside a deprecation pattern.

## Acceptance notes

- Downstream: the ops manual (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#113) can drop its "the command fails" line once a release carries #33879. No release carries it yet: `packages/cli/package.json` is at `18.5.0` on `main`, `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` has no entry for it, and `.changeset/33608-migrate-ownership-queue.md` (patch on `@objectstack/cli`) is still pending. It ships in the first `@objectstack/cli` release after 18.5.0.
- The sealing child boots from a copy of the artifact without `queues` / `assignmentRules`. It stands for whatever served the ledger. The subject here is the command's boot, not the sealer's.
- This file spawns two Node processes (one seal, one verify) and runs for about 9 s of test time, 22 s wall with collection, which is over the 10 s file line. It declares no `test-budget:` header, because that header needs a CI reading this PR does not have yet. The sibling `verify.integration.test.ts` has the same shape.

## Verification

All readings are on `746ae96f` (the merge of `origin/main` into this branch) unless a line names another head. After the merge, the dependency closure was rebuilt (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`, exit 0) before any test ran.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- New file, integration tier: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/audit/verify.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 2 passed (2)`. It was also green at `65106259`, before the merge.
- Tier partition pin `test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts`: `Tests 22 passed (22)`. The new file is classified in the integration tier.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck: OK`. `tsc -p tsconfig.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new file, so the program compiles it.
- Not run locally: the full cli unit tier. This diff changes no unit-tier file and no shipped byte. Two attempts got no turn on the shared verify lock (`VERDICT queue-timeout (exit 99)`). CI `Test Core` runs it.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the 18.5.0 composition (red), then restored</summary>

- Mutation, landed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `bootSchemaStack` never uses the provider (`if (ownershipQueueProvider && process.env.OS_ABLATION_NEVER)`). The on-disk counts were marker 1 and anchor 0, and the blob went from `de7da81e` to `b3f7180b`. The command runs from `src/` through `bin/run-dev.js` (tsx), so there is no `dist/` leg for this file.
- Result at `8883cc9c`: `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`. Case 1 exited 2, and its `--json` document was the card's refusal: `{"error":"boot_failed","message":"[ObjectQLPlugin] the stack declares queues (1) and assignmentRules (1), but no 'ownership-queue' service is registered, so no queue would resolve and no assignment rule would route a row. Add @objectstack/plugin-sharing to the composition (it registers 'ownership-queue'); the job-queue service named 'queue' is a different service and does not serve ownership queues."}`.
- Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts` (trap). `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the blob is back to `de7da81e`, the HEAD blob.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 54 commands at `746ae96f`. All 54 were run, and 52 exited 0. `--ran` with exit codes: `54 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 52 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`). It needs every package built; CI builds them.
- `check:i18n-coverage`: NOT MEASURED (exit 3, a partial round, so nothing was compared).
- `check:type-check-debt`: exit 0, `check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK`.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived model mandate. The declarations are `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, because the diff adds a test and changes no accepted input or published surface.

</details>
